values: A two-tail obstruction to ambient conjugation in Dlab groups — Alec Kriebel; v1.0.0. Preprint and Zenodo publication date: 2026-10-17. Affirmative answer to the corrected ambient-conjugation formulation of Kourovka 21.149: an order automorphism of the compact-support powers-of-two Dlab group remains nonconjugational after every embedding into any standard real Dlab group, with unrestricted ambient slopes and no order-preservation assumption on the embedding. Credits the prior original-formulation Lean solution and Gong–Yang–Zeng’s rank-one six-family theorem; originality assessment is bounded. Six-page AI-assisted preprint; two fresh sequential full-package AI adversarial reviews found no outstanding substantive objections. No independent human peer review or formal verification of the new theorem. Includes LaTeX source, exact formula verifier, source/priority audits and review reports. Public record: https://zenodo.org/records/23441890
